versions.changelog:
- Add detailed documentation for Xiaoqinli (XQL) AST-first transpiler, covering type system, node kinds, error codes, and workflow
- Specify support for compiling .xql.json files to Go, Rust, TypeScript, Kotlin, Swift, and Python
- Highlight static checks for type safety, effect inference, and capability validation
- Provide installation instructions and code examples for easier onboarding
